Bounded Next Action

Bounded Next Action workflow for coding agents. Use when an unfinished task needs one executable next step.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Select one unblocked action; include its target and completion check.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: The schema is migrated. What next?

Backfill the new column, then check null counts.

Use the helper

next_action

Source: skills/bounded-next-action/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
